The awards ceremony was held live on September 14, 2026, at the Peacock Theater in Downtown Los Angeles, California, and was preceded by the 78th Primetime Creative Arts Emmy Awards on September 5 and 6. The ceremony was produced by Jesse Collins Entertainment and broadcast in the United States by NBC and Peacock. The ceremony was produced by Jesse Collins Entertainment, directed by Alex Rudzinski, and broadcast in the United States by NBC and Peacock. Mariska Hargitay hosted the event. At the main ceremony, Widow's Bay led all programs with six awards including Outstanding Comedy Series, and The Pitt won two awards including Outstanding Drama Series. Other winning programs included Pluribus with two awards, and The Beast in Me, DTF St. Louis, Hacks, The Late Show with Stephen Colbert, Remarkably Bright Creatures, Slow Horses, and The Traitors with one each. Including Creative Arts Emmys, Widow's Bay led all shows with 14 wins, while Apple TV led all networks with 28 wins.

[Эмми (премия, 2026)] 78-я церемония вручения прайм-тайм премии «Эмми» (англ. 78th Primetime Emmy Awards) — церемония вручения главной телевизионной премии США, присуждаемая лучшим телепрограммам года, вышедшим в прайм-тайм в период с 1 июня 2025 по 31 мая 2026 года. Церемония состоялась 14 сентября 2026 года в Peacock Theater (Лос-Анджелес) и транслировалась по телеканалу NBC. Продюсером церемонии выступила компания Jesse Collins Entertainment, а ведущей — Маришка Харгитей. Она стала первой женщиной-ведущей «Эмми» за последние 15 лет.
